FX-WRITEON-001.says: The settings as added: the brush at the middle and never moved, Brush Size 6, Hardness 75, white: every mark at the same place, one white dot in the middle.

FX-WRITEON-002.says: The brush keyed from 10, 50 at frame 0 to 90, 50 at frame 8, Brush Size 3, Brush Spacing 0.02 seconds: a white line written on left to right along the middle, a dot at frame 0, reaching the right at frame 8.

FX-WRITEON-003.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Brush Spacing 0.25 seconds (6 frames): marks far apart, one dot at frame 4, two at frame 8.

FX-WRITEON-004.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Stroke Length 0.1 seconds (2.4 frames): only the last 0.1 seconds of the line, a short dash travelling right.

FX-WRITEON-005.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Hardness 0: soft from its middle out.

FX-WRITEON-006.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Hardness 100: hard, smoothed over one pixel.

FX-WRITEON-007.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Brush Opacity 50: half covered at most.

FX-WRITEON-009.says: FX-WRITEON-002 On Transparent: the line alone, the drawing gone.

FX-WRITEON-010.says: FX-WRITEON-002 Reveal Original Image: the drawing only under the line, the colour unused.

FX-WRITEON-011.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with Brush Size 0: nothing is drawn; the drawing, untouched.

FX-WRITEON-012.says: Brush Size 0, On Transparent: nothing at all.

FX-WRITEON-013.says: Brush Size keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 8, Brush Time Properties None: the whole line takes the size now, thin at frame 2 and thick at frame 8.

FX-WRITEON-014.says: FX-WRITEON-013 with Brush Time Properties Size: each mark keeps the size it was laid with, so the line swells from thin on the left to thick on the right.

FX-WRITEON-015.says: Hardness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 8, Brush Size 5, Brush Time Properties Hardness: soft on the left, hard on the right.

FX-WRITEON-016.says: FX-WRITEON-014 with Hardness keyed too, from 0 to 100, Brush Time Properties Size & Hardness: thin and soft to thick and hard.

FX-WRITEON-017.says: Brush Opacity keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 8, Paint Time Properties None: the whole line fades together, to 20 at frame 8.

FX-WRITEON-018.says: FX-WRITEON-017 with Paint Time Properties Opacity: each mark keeps its opacity, so the line fades from solid on the left to faint on the right.

FX-WRITEON-019.says: FX-WRITEON-017 with Paint Time Properties Color: the colour cannot be keyed, so FX-WRITEON-017's frame.

FX-WRITEON-020.says: FX-WRITEON-017 with Paint Time Properties Color & Opacity: FX-WRITEON-018's frame.

FX-WRITEON-021.says: The brush keyed through three places, 10, 20 at frame 0, 50, 80 at frame 4 and 90, 20 at frame 8: a V written on.

FX-WRITEON-022.says: The brush held at 25, 50 until frame 4, then at 75, 50: two dots by frame 8, no line between.

FX-WRITEON-023.says: FX-WRITEON-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-WRITEON-024.says: FX-WRITEON-002 on a layer that starts at frame 2: nothing before it, and the first mark laid at frame 2, where the brush then is.

FX-WRITEON-025.says: Brush Opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, Paint Time Properties Opacity: each mark's opacity held at 100 before it is used.

FX-WRITEON-026.says: FX-WRITEON-003's spacing with Stroke Length 0.1 seconds: at frame 4 the only mark is older than its length, so nothing is drawn; at frame 8 the second mark, laid two frames before, is.

FX-WRITEON-027.says: FX-WRITEON-002 on a layer stretched to 200 per cent: the keys and the marks stretch with it, so frame 8 is FX-WRITEON-002's frame 4.

FX-WRITEON-028.says: Brush Position at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-029.says: Brush Size 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-030.says: Brush Size -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-031.says: Brush Hardness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-032.says: Brush Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-033.says: Stroke Length -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-034.says: Stroke Length 3601, above 3600 seconds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-035.says: Brush Spacing 0, below 0.001 seconds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-036.says: Brush Spacing 11, above 10 seconds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-037.says: Paint Time Properties "size", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WRITEON-038.says: Brush Time Properties "color", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
